hook: Why can't a React component just change its own props?

segments.narration: Props are the inputs to a component. A parent passes them down, and the child reads them as a single object.
Props are read only. To change what is shown over time, a component uses state instead.

key_claims.text: A component must not modify its own props; it uses state for values that change.
key_claims.quote: Props are read-only. A component must never modify its own props; to change what is shown over time it uses state instead.

sources.title: Source card: Components and props in React

retrieval_items.prompt: A child component needs to show a value that changes over time. What should it use?
retrieval_items.explanation: Props are read-only, so values that change over time belong in state.
